text: I am experiencing significant frustration with the persistent bugs within this game. Despite numerous attempts to resolve these issues, including logging out and back in, reinstalling the game, and waiting several weeks, the same problems persist. I have confirmed that these issues are not related to my network hardware or internet service. The game consistently glitches, frequently prompting me to "Retry to connect" this started when they rolled out the new season. Fix it!

Controller player, by the way.

This is probably the best FPS game you can find on mobile platforms. It's fun as hell and has many different ways to play: whether you want a short match or a long Battle Royale game, its all there for you. Graphics are solid, controls are really well optimized, controller support is cool, it's overall just a great game. I made a review a while back asking for classic Zombies and they DID bring it back and it is a joy to play. All I can ask for now is more classic Zombies maps. Highly recommend.

The game is really good and surprisingly well optimized even for old devices, somehow running 60 fps on a 12 year old phone. the only issues I have are that the AK-47 feels unappreciated (there aren't enough camos) and there is some controller jank with some controllers, and the execution animations are rather slow compared to other CoD titles like CoD4:MW (basing off the DS version), but these things aren't a huge problem, compared to how nearly everything costs money, which isn't fun.

Game could be 5 stars but there are some issues. I started playing in 2022 (Radical Raid) the game has made a lot of improvements since then but also gotten worse. Second, the random bugs, such as mic going into friends instead of team, random audio spurts, random MS spikes, random lag, (My phone is good, also got good internet) and the random kicking from the game. Love this game tho.

It would allow players to experience tactical operations, global missions, and dramatic moments similar to console..

I want to enjoy *Call of Duty*, but the frequent respawn-side changes during matches make modes like TDM and Frontline genuinely frustrating. It disrupts the flow of combat, so players end up coming from all different directions instead of it feeling tactical and consistent. Worst of all, it can feel like we lose not because of skill, but because the enemy respawn side suddenly changed in their favor. The creators really need to adjust this—respawns should be less random or more predictable.

​The rewards are good, but they are scattered across too many different menus. As a returning player, the interface feels overwhelming and cluttered, disrupting the game's core design. It is easy to leave rewards unclaimed due to this fragmentation and redundant navigation buttons. I suggest unifying all reward mechanics into a single, centralized section to prevent confusing navigation and visual clutter, especially for new players. Overall the game is good, but UX needs improvement.

I honestly believe that this game will hit #1 game of the year for our mobile platforms. Excellent graphics, excellent shooter game mechanics, beautiful guns, loads of extra nice perks. The real deal! Just like the Call of Duty game on the PlayStation but transferred over onto our Android powered mobile devices, it infiltrated itself into that little device in the palm of your hands. ..finally.

Played this game from the start, loved it at first, even met my husband through the game.. however, I had to spend almost £100 just to get a legendary weapon, the prices are far too high for a game that is now laggy and glitchy, I often have black screen too. My phone had good ram and memory and I always have ping around 15 so it's obviously the game. If only you cared about your customers more than money.

The gameplay is quite enjoyable. Multiplayer has a great selection of game modes, which are fun, and can be quite intense. The weapon options and customisations are pretty good too. Zombies was a fun addition, and I hope to see that return. Attack of the Undead was great, and I enjoy the newer special games too. Battle Royale is great with the full map, and the options for weaponry and classes is pretty extensive. Overall, this is my favourite mobile game. Easy 5/5.

great game, they put the effort in and utilised all the capabilities of a phone for a game. My only problem is Battle Royale. I feel weapons should be waaaaaay more scarce and generally the other players are really bad and there are too few of them, so it's just way too easy. I'd like the games to be longer and more scavenging, instead of everything given to you on a plate. make it a proper survival sandbox

One of the rare good mobile games. Finally something that isn't just a city builder that forces you to buy gems to actually play. The controls are surprisingly usable considering I hate using touch screen for controls too. Great game with several modes available and popups only happen upon login and after matches. You are not forced to buy anything in order to play.

finally a console game comes to mobile! i'm not a fan of "idler" or "clicker titles". i prefer to drop in and play something more engaging for a moment while i have spare time. this is perfect for that! while the engine is obviously different from the console games' IWtech, meaning a learning curve for COD veterans, tencent really killed it on this game!

Like playing the Call of Duty game of old. I would like to make a suggestion. In the Battle Royale gameplay, it would be a refreshing sight if you could add another map besides the ISOLATED map. Another point I would like to share is if you could allow the customization of the character's gender and ethnicity (this minor expansion may require you to hire voice actors). With the expense you will incur now if you undertake this suggestions, the long-term benefits outweigh it all. I assure you.

As a previous pubg player, I was keen to download. I enjoy the use of the helicopter and the wingsuits when playing battle royale. It's great that you can use merits whilst moving. I do think the map could be bigger. And I think the supply boxes could also be way better. Its only the arctic .50 exotic that is of any use when playing this game.

This game is great and has a lot of potential. It brings me back to black ops days with firing range, nuke town, and summit. I enjoy the game a lot but it seems like the people who would play the sniper don't have many options for snipers other than the DL Q33 and the Arctic. I also think that you should add some more map variety. I understand that this is just a mobile game at the end of the day but having a larger variety for maps would make the game much better.

I hope most people realise that the game, because it's so large, it really requires a higher-end device to play. I'm afraid yer regular iPhone 6 may barely be able to keep up anymore which is why it may be more frequently laggy than it should be. That's just the nature of it, because we don't have as much of that issue. Ours are way deeper than that 😂 Although the game can be frustrating, you can't argue it's still the best mobile game out there in the market currently.

The game is amazing, the graphics looks astonishing, everything about this game looks great. I'm looking forward for more content and more updates. The only thing I think is bad is the skins taking place of the weapons, and that adds a bit of pay to win in the game. But the matchmaking of the game seems to balance the things out. Good game, and I think everyone should at least give it a shot. Keep up with the good work!

Clean game! When I saw a CoD to mobile I was expecting waaay less then what it actually has to offer. The gameplay is very smooth and easy to adapt. The graphs are OK, but there is only low quality available yet, so I think that they will be beautiful soon. There are 2 game modes, with at least one more on the way. Lots of weaphons with skins and add on's. Now tell me; what the hecc can you ask more from a mobile shooter?! NOTHING! Congratulations to the dev's, this is a console/pc worth game!

Ive been a call of duty player for years now, and the one thing that bugs me the most is, i spend my money to buy a skin and yet people cant see it, like,WHATS THE POINT. I think in the matchmaking room, there should be a button to let you download your teammates skins. It's so frustrating. Aside that, its a lovely game and i dont think I'll ever leave.

First of, kudos to activition for COD. The game is good. But player get to experience server glitches, especially in battle royale matches, when there are lots of opponents in a particular map or area. And as such you can't get to kill your opponent. Which allows them to easily kill a player's avatar. It seems that people cheat in the game, by distrupting network or other means. The developer should ensure everybody play on level ground. I hope they get it right in COD warzone on mobile platform

The game is extremely awesome. With the graphics and game play was very smooth. Enjoyable, playing with experience players, communication in the game is amazing. There is no more than I can say. But, I hope I can invite my friends into the training ground to train together. By the way, the game was very great and amazing 👏 thumbs up for that Call Of Duty.

An amazing fps game where you can play with your friends. However I cannot download it for few days, since I remove COD Mobile for some personal reason. I've got an efficient wifi and data, then the storage of my phone is large. Maybe the matter comes from the Play Store App. Yet, this matter isn't fixed I'll let a 2 stars (same if the game deserves 4/5 stars).

The game is fun aside from the P2W elements on weapons and cosmetics (that's supposed to be purely esthetics). Lots of glitches, can't reconnect to the game as of now. I tried reinstalling the game (by the way, 23 GB of storage is ridiculously alot for a mobile game it urgently needs optimizations) been playing since 2019, but it's getting too much to handle, please fix it...

I now give 2 stars since the issue is still not fixed. (updated) The game is amazing, there's a few things that makes me give 3 stars instead of 5 though, there's a huge gap in the game, like when I am shooting a player I find that I am not shooting it at all.. Plus the game is always crashing.. I hope you fix the issues as soon as possible..

You know this game is pretty nice. It has all the content from other COD titles (ex. gun skins, characters and character skins, maps etc.). It used to be very fun to play this game, but now IDK why but I lost my interest in it. I just can't seem to like it anymore. It doesn't make any sense, one day I was addicted to it and then the other I coudn't even play 2 matches other than me forcing myself to play it. It isn't only me; a lot of my friends also pointed this out and YouTubers too.

Would be 5 stars the team death match feels a lot shorter due to the 40 kill cap this means it can be reached by 2 people on your team while the rest do nothing. Mobile data players good addition but it appears that they lag around the map and you can't kill them because they've appeared out of nowhere, the credits feel like they have no use in the game as it takes ages to gain enough just to buy 1 item from the store would be better if you could buy crates with them. still a very good game

The tutorial is ridiculous. For the first minutes after starting the game I had no freedom at all. I was guided through different menus and the second thing I was shown was the store. Why did the devs assume tyey have to hold your hand over the simplest of options is beyond me. Probably a good game but I've never uninstalled anything so fast.

The game is good but when it comes to the 100 play mood the icons are too big and confusing. Hope you will fix it on the nest update. If you guys can make the icons and the description smaller on the loot box would be much more easier to select what we want from the loot box. Anyway what an awesome game. Always love call of duty games. The best.

It's a really good game, especially since I started playing it after quitting PUBGM. I kinda wish, though, that it wasn't quite so expensive to buy and then fully upgrade any mythics you own in the game. Even so, It's beginner friendly and quite easy to get to grips with the playing style, and the number of possible loadouts are impressive as well as the sheer amount of guns that are available to the player which they can use to beat enemies. I definitely recommend it!

"One of the best games I've ever played, but the constant updates are a huge problem. I absolutely love Call of Duty Mobile—it's thrilling, engaging, and keeps me coming back for more. However, there’s one major issue that keeps bothering me: the frequent updates. It feels like every month there's a new update, and just when you think you've downloaded everything, all your progress, including maps and other game data, gets wiped. As a result, I have to redownload everything again,fix this.

The only thing I can say. Is if you want something bad, it costs a little bit. Besides that it's good. Oh, and this is for the group that built this game. It's not letting me back in it says that it needs an update, but there's is no update available. And even tho I have a full, I still aren't allowed to enter.

Big time CoD fan! After about 2 months of playtime, I realized that the Credits (In-game currency) that you earn gradually as you play is pretty much useless. The game forces you to buy more Credits and/or CP if you want to buy anything that's in the in-game store. Apart from that aspect, I love the quests, maps, game modes, and overall gameplay mechanics. As someone who's played a whole lot of FPS Android shooters, this is the closest experience you can get compared to playing on PC.

I have been playing Call of Duty on console since the first game came out. I have stuck by ever since buying and dominating each game that got released. I have played in clans, game battles, scrims and I am a YouTuber. This game for the mobile is one of the best. I am by far no mobile gamer but the controls are easy, the game play is smooth and so far I have not experienced any issues with how the game runs, connection nor how the game mechanics work. Keep up the good work.

Brilliant game, everything is exceptional, my only issue is the amount of money needed to be spent to get mythic or legendary weapons, in Amerika it might not be bad, but in south African currency it's extremely expensive, as in more than R5000 for basic stuff. which gives other players a big advantage. And 1 other problem is the bots that infest the game, for instance search and destroy the idiot bot picks up the bomb and does nothing with it, or if your entire team are bots, it's chaos.

Amazing game, but pls optimize the game for low to mid range phones to play smoothly without lag or over heating. too much of all this legendary and mythic resources (skins) are stressing my phone's CPU and GPU, if you can reduce render distance and effect particles in BR to reduce lag. having mythics and legendary is useless when you can't even use or play with them. pls ACTIVISION TAKE THIS INTO CONSIDERATION

Well I got things to say! First of all, let me just clear this out, this game is indeed the best game on mobile right now! The game was really fun, etc. But after the major update, I couldn't play any gamemodes for most of the time! I clicked on a certain gamemode and joined the lobby, but I got stuck there! It didn't take me into the game to start playing, instead it just loads for a few moments and says 'unable to connect to the game, please try again." I tried again and still didn't work.

Fantastic mobile FPS. Love playing. It's free for the most part, except when cool stuff comes out. Items can be really expensive. It would be really awesome if there was a skip all button function when a game ends, so you just go back to your lobby right away. Instead, I have to wait and press at least half a dozen next buttons, if not more until I can get back to the lobby. The COD Mobile team needs to address the inappropriate gamertag's. A censor filter would be good when choosing names.

I see mine revive had been deleted, nice! I will write it again. Game is good but only for few hours. It lacks in everything, only two game modes with few maps which repeat all over and it's getting boring. There is not much content in game. Prizes are hilarious as well as prices in game shop. There are few weapons you can buy and the price of it is soo high compared to what you can earn in game. Prizes for lvl, ranking up or daily are a joke you could as well give nothing at all. Game is boring

The game is very fun, and I've spent a good time on it. But then I just got an annoying problem that I can't link to my Facebook account. When I link to it, it logs in another account instead of my old one that used to log in when connected by facebook. Well, I just got upset and unnistalled the game, despite all the fun it is still very frustrating. I lost some time on that account. The account still exists when I search for it, but there is no way to connect to it.

Monetization is all over the place, and most of it is basically gambling for the items you want. The listed percent chances for any valuable item from a crate are extremely low (0.5-2%) and can only be obtained from those crates. Crates are around $2 USD, odds are you'll spend around $50 before seeing one. Blue and purple rarity items have a small buff that normal and green items do not. Core gameplay is extremely solid and intuitive but the monetization is predatory.

There is a lot of details in this game. Many ways to have fun. The gameplay is not bad. But there is too many update. Servers are not great. AND Tooooooo many baits for spending money! THIS GAME IS ONE OF THE MOST ANNOYING "PAY TO WIN" GAMES TODATE!!! The difference between players who payed for weapon upgrades and players who just progressed with no payment is massive!

I loved this game before. Now it's an absolute nightmare to play.. It takes forever getting into BR...that's if you get a match. I am really disappointed that it turned out like this. I had some great times on CODM but if they dont improve all the glitches , slow loading times and so many other issues then I believe a lot of players will stop playing the game. It's disappointing that it came down to this. Let's see in the future ...Maybe it goes back to being great again!!

I love open world type games so I've played heaps of games on my phone and have really enjoyed a few of them. I always loved playing COD on PS4 but I don't play it anymore. This is hands down the best game on a phone ever. It's awesome, constant updates and always keeping it fresh. 1 negative: In game purchases are WAY TO EXPENSIVE! I suspect if you made things cheaper you'd have more people buy it which means although lowering the cost upfront the volume would be higher thus a bigger turn over!

I give the game a 1 star. It's fun, relaxing and worth playing, but the in game purchasers are to expensive for most who have the game, hence the lesser stars. The zombies mode isn't permanent either which is a downside, and there is almost no creativity in the game. As soon as a gun gets buffed it gets nerfed next season which is unfair in my opinion. I have so much to say but so little space so I'll leave my complaints at that.

The game is all good ,fun and competitive but I have a major issue. I recently bought samsung A 37 and started playing the multi-player mode even in low graphics + max fps settings i am getting 60 fps. for the same mode i get 60 fps in very high graphics + very high fps so that means my device can easily support upto 90 fps in low graphics +max fps I like this game a lot and I am playing this from 2019 and I want to experience this wonderful game in 90 fps for a smoother gameplay refreshrate=120

I've been playing this game since the day it was released. I have a mid-range device that completes all the requirements they recommend. First, It was good at handling the game very well. but as the large updates came by it was not enough. Now the game is laggy and can't handle the game very well. I love this game. ❤ Please consider fixing these problems. 🙏 And south asian players can't play competitive games as their ping is above 100ms. We always get thown into some japanese servers.

This is a great game. The very fact I like about this game is that the firing button is not there in some phones and the gun will automatically fire when aimed at enemies. There are so many types of guns, RPGs, grenades, arrows, etc. Going forward, it is very difficult to play this game because enemies would gear up with RPGs and stuff like that. But, I liked this game because it has a mission. Call of Duty is everything, you can play it like FreeFire and you can play with teammates.

Well I only got this game to play the zombies but then found it has been discontinued, I don't understand why because quite a lot of people enjoyed it and had a lot of potential because now there is no way to play COD: Zombies on mobile anymore because the other game has been removed from the Google Play Store. But the multiplayer is decent at least, would be better if it wasn't as 'pay to win' through all the loot crates would be better if it was like a standard game where you unlock them.

I've played this nearly every day since I first started playing the game back in 2019, & I have had no issues until the latest season update. I can play the game no problem, but I am missing quite a few of the main sound effects, including the countdown into the matches, so I sometimes miss the start which isn't always a good thing. So if anyone who actually makes the game reads this, any chance you can sort this issue, because as it stands the game for me is more about watching the clock.

Really nice game, love the gameplay and graphics. But something really annoying about COD, the fact that other players have to download my skin and 'EMOTE' before they can see it! I don't see any reason to make any more in-game purchases due to this reason, it's really frustrating and takes out the fun of owning skins and emotes. Please do something about this, developers. Other than this, the game is a 5 star for me.

I absolutely love the game, loving the social side, and diversity of the game. I do have an issue with the updates though. 5GB updates every 3 or 4 weeks becomes a bit of a chore. Weapon camos alone was 1.5 GBs! Hopefully the programmers can come up with a way of compressing this in future as it can take over an hour to upgrade which is a bit of a buzz kill. Great game though 😊

The only thing that forms a discontent is me is the weight of the game, which are 3GB (almost 4) and more the secondary downloads that it sends you to download in the game such as the camouflage of weapons, maps, characters. That is, literally once you download all the data of the game you get to weigh 10GB and a little more. In my opinion to be a game dedicated to the "mobile" line weighs too much, only people who have a cell phone of the gamer type could play.

Game is good. However, the support is useless. I had mistakenly set a wrong name for my ID therefore I wanted to create a new ID. But there was literally no way to unlink the current game from my Facebook Account. When told support about this the only option they gave me was to continue with the game or purchase a very expensive name change card. It would've been good and I would've made in-app purchases if I knew I could count on the support team. It's a good game btw.

I love this game, but like two months ago it has a bug on my device that makes it impossible to be on a call (like using discord) while playing because the game's sound gets trashy and low. I literally have to end the call and call again, play with the volumen, try different configurations, until it finally starts working. This only happens with this game, tho. And it's impossible to play a fps game without hearing where the bullets and enemies are coming from... I have an Infinix Gt20 pro

I have been playing this game since its early access(2019) the game in itself is amazing. There is just one flaw, and its the size. Now I know that great games does require an amount of storage. But if the size is just so big people would just go to other games like pubg mobile. But, the rest of the game is just amazing. The maps, characters, gunskins, meta and the game balance is just perfect

Multiplayer is better than Battle Royal. I'm agree that best gameplay . But there are several issues that has to be fix immediately by developers. 1) Game ping rising up to 199 & keep quitting players from the on going game. 2) THERE IS NO SUBMIT BUTTON IN THE BUG REPORT SCREEN & they ask for a description of the bug . Then i typed one and immediately the "SUBMIT" button didn't show.

This is the first mobile FPS game I have played in a long time and actually enjoyed. Then you ruined it by dropping controller support. If it wasn't meant to be in the game in the first place than it shouldn't of been there at all. Now that players like myself got used to the idea of using a controller, it's gone. You should of just left it there. Uninstalled.

Great mobile port for cod, but the lootcrate rates are displayed as deceptive as possible. I'm very familiar with gacha/lootboxes from other games, but at least other games give the actual odds of winning something. The way the odds are displayed here is they just they you the possibilty of getting a certain grade, but not the rates for individual drops. The unwanted drops, eg credits, are much higher then the featured items of same rarity.

I have been playing this game since i don't know when..maybe from the time when PC gaming was done at gaming parlours. Now finding this game in mobile with exactly every single thing is nostalgic. Love everything about the game. A note of thanks to the developers. Also there are some bugs in the Battle Royale, may be you guys can sort it out in the next update. I am playing the game at max fps, but when i scope in, it gets stuck and the game blacks out.

The game itself is great, but to take up 18 gb's of someone's mobile device just too much. Although it is glitchy, it is fun and a great game to play but it's hard to sacrifice storage space, most phones just simply don't have it. Although I love it and have played a long ways, I got to delete it simply for the storage, are there things run like s*** because there's no space left .

This has been my favourite game the whole year. It deserves a praise. It has so much to offer. So many different game modes. Like it was a lot of games merged into one. Everything works smoothly. Each detail of the game is thoughtfully created, from moves of the characters, precise aiming, personalising the weapons... I have never played such a detailed, rich, well made game in my entire life. This game is not play to win. You can spend 0 and still be the best player. THANK YOU ACTIVISION!!!!!

It used to be good, as you had for long time players the skins that they could earn for achievements, or even a store to buy certain items, now all you have is a casino, roll the dice, spin the wheel, this shouldnt be available for kids either. Maybe this review will be now deleted aswell, as mentioning "leave the kids alone" will get you into trouble with the CallOfG.

The best game ever. Those people who are facing problems like frame rates drop, lags, storage problem, should check their phone first whether it is compatible or not with the game. Don't blame the game, it is the best game till now. You all play and praise BGMI and Free Fire because they require less storage and are more compatible. But this doesn't mean that you'll blame the game. Go check your device first. For me this is the best game of all time!!

No ads, a collection of characters, competition...who could ask for more? It's a great game if you're competitive or like to vs the AI, and u can have a dog. The only thing that drops this to 4 stars is COD points. There is no way you can earn any without real money. So I ask of the developers to put in ways to earn COD points for the skint people like me! Note: I also would say that the game doesn't take too much data away from you if you play with 4G etc. GOOD GAME OVERALL WILL RECCOMEND!

I liked CODM in past when it has released, it was a real military war, but now I don't like as I do in the past. It contains a lot of colourful skins, weapons, characters, cars, etc. We don't want these skins for anything, just return the game to its basic -Real military game-. Now, I'm playing with stock weapons without any camo or skin. That's how we need it.

Call of duty mobile is a great game, good graphics, good skins and many more, although there are some bugs, I still consider this game great, I love the fact that you can get cod points for free, overall amazing game!

An amazing game for your mobile, especially if you're like me, don't have the time or money for a games console. There are options to invest money in the game, but with a few of the wide variety matches it's so easy to build up your class. Play it while chilling at home, at your desk on your break or on the go. To say it's for smart phones the graphics are fairly good, though the 5th star would be for better ones

I love this game, even though it can be frustrating at times. The game isn't quite a pay to win game, but it runs on people purchasing cp. The game match making is ok, Although you will always get a few bots in your game. I've spent around $20 on this game, to get skins and weapons, which don't really affect game play. The main problem is the lagging of the game, it lags out all the time, but its never seemed to bother me but I've read alot of these reviews, and many people struggle with the lag

Love the game. Gameplay, graphics, it's all amazing. Runs super smooth. I'm really sad Zombies got removed tho. That was really fun. I also find it kind of bumming how all the good stuff is only bought with CP coins, which u can only get by buying with real money. I get you have to make money, even with a free COD game, but it's a bit expensive and you have to buy a lot to get some good stuff. Other than that, great game.

It hasn't been long since I downloaded the game,like last month,but I must say I'm enjoying the game. I like how you're able to team up with people and also go solo and do your own stuffs, it's really cool. And there are also a lot of modes in the game as well which makes it fun. But one major thing the game ain't good at is how it consumes storage. Like it literally sucks all your space gradually and if your phone ain't got like more than 20GB storage, I wouldn't recommend you download it.

Call of Duty has always been my favourite game , pc /ps now on mobile, same fun same thrill. Haven't missed a single edition , no plans missing in near future. There are a few glitches in the game after last update . Character does not speak out the pre defined messages one of my character doesn't say" Don't Rush" other character have another issues.

The game is awesome for what it is. Gunplay feels great and rewarding and it actually feels like cod. My biggest issue are bots. I'm not sure how many of them there actually are in games but it seems like there are only ever 1 or 2 real players on the enemy team, casual or ranked. Also it's nearly impossible for me to find a ranked game. Just times out after 1 minute of searching. Been trying to find a game for almost a half hour last night

Overall the graphics are amazing, gameplay is so far so good. Controls are something to get used to but still easy to play. Eould give a full 5 star rating if matchmaking was better, been top of my team every game 15-20 kills with 3-5 deaths with the rest of my team going negative and causing me to lose the game. Other than that really good job on the game been enjoying my time playing

I love the game but when you spend money, the odds of getting the good weapon are very slim. They'll make you purchase everything else first. When you purchase the battle pass, you get good things in the beginning and even in the middle. But near the end, you don't get anything. They want you to purchase an additional pass. That's not fair... As the other review stated, matchmaking isn't exactly fair. It should really include skill level as well. Aside from that, it's fun and addicting!

Honestly if this doesn't get game of the year award, i don't know what will. This is the best thing that's ever happened for a long time for mobile gamers and those lacking a console or pc decent enough to play those games. But now, connect it to a tv or controller support, that would be like playing actual COD on a console knowing the quality isn't that amazing but its pretty good so far in a Oneplus 6T.

You could have added a control support, I've waited several months to download the game and even bought a controller for it, but there's no gamepad support. I understand that it's a free AAA mobile game, but you also could've added more items to buy via in game money. It is an excellent game though, one of the best movies fps out there, I'm eager to rate 5 stars when you add gamepad support!

Edit: new updates have become very disappointing. From glitches and loading issues to 347 seconds waiting time for a match on good, Fibre Optic internet. I play on my Huawei Y9 Prime and have never had problems with other games. Been discouraged with the amount of "questionably legitimate players" and the match making has become a free for all. This is my favorite game and I'm hoping these issues can be sorted out so that it stays this way. And yes, I spend money on it.

Its actually really fun to play. The only problem i have is the micro transactions. The paywall was bad enough when the game first released and now it got made worse with the zombies update. I don't mind making micro transactions just cosmetic items but when you start adding weapons that you can not get any other way then it becomes serious BS. Going for the jugular with the prices also. I put money into the game to buy a few chests and got nothing but in game currency. Ridiculous prices.

Easily one of the best mobile games, and I've played a lot. CoD mobile is pretty much what you'd expect from a full console game. Graphics aren't as good as on console or PC, controls aren't perfect but are reasonable, which is more than you can say for most ports. Voice chat is rarely used, and normally by people in another language, but you get the same thing on console. You get online MP, battle royale and zombies, with no P2W elements, all for free, and it's still being added to.

This is the best online shooter game , no argument . But Im from South Africa and there are no servers around here , so it makes the game lag and be frustrating sometimes . You will freeze for about 2 seconds then resume for about 10 seconds, only to find out you were killed during those 2 minutes . But , Great Game after all .

As far as mobile shooters go, this is one of the best. I actually prefer it to the modern games on PC, my only complaint is that the Zombies mode leaves a lot to be desired. I'd love to see some of the classic maps, such as Der Riese and Kino Der Toten added with the round-based system. Otherwise, as far as the multiplayer and warzone modes go, it's pretty good.

I played this game on my tablet and it was fun I was winning lodes and I was also grinding there was no lag for me and it was a real fun game I totally think you should try this on a tablet as it is a bigger screen and is way easier because of the controls being big enough. If you want to play this on a phone suggest buying a controller as it will be easier. I give this 10/10. Add-On the graphics are really,really cool and they seem nearly as good as Console Call Of Duty games.🎮

It's incredible how well they have translated the controls of COD/MOD into a mobile format. Sound is spot on, gave me some decent nostalgia feels. Play with headphones, far easier to hear an opponent coming your way. On the graphics - the devs have made it super easy to spot an enemy player, so after a few rounds of practice, you'll be fragging like a pro. The only negative is possible the microtransactions, but who the F cares? Just ignore it - you level up quickly and the game throws new upgrades at you. There is battle royale, ranked and casual multiplayer currently. Can't wait to see what else COD Mobile has for me. Just download it!!!

I love this game. It's by far the best multiplayer FPS on mobile platform I've ever played. A lot of my friends have this app and we all really enjoy playing it in our free time. Amazing game, Amazing match making, Amazing balance, no pay to win b.s, no adverts...so many modes. So many levels to choose from. This is an excellent and amazing game. Best game on the store by far. No ads, free to play (but skin purchase are optional) easy at the start but it can get quite competitive when you level. As someone who rarely plays any games and is bad at games (especially FPS), I find this game surprisingly easy to play. I thought that I would not even be able to shoot a single person before going down, but the 'simple' option made it way easier. Other than that, the controls are great, it looks nice, and it plays well on my fairly old phone. The only gripe I have with this game is the lack of an offline mode, as I usually play games only when I can't access the internet to do something else.

This is undoubtedly the best FPS mobile shooting game I have ever seen. The gameplay is smooth if you have a stable internet connection and a good phone. The variety of weapons and characters is great. (Features almost every character from different Call Of Duty game series). The skins are fantastic. (Legendary skins are a bit too expensive, I'm a pay to player and it is too expensive for me as well). Both the multiplayer and the battle royale are amazing. BEST MOBILE GAME OF THE 21ST CENTURY.

call of duty mobile is an awesome game (if your willing to give up 30GB of storage). it has tons of game modes, maps, characters and guns. it's great to hangout, play with friends or just have fun in general. the controls are easy to get used to and the tutorial teaches the basics you need. my only downsides to this game is that you cannot play without wifi and the occasional lag i experience every once in a while. edit: the game crashes more often, not just BR. edit 2: clear storage so no crash

Literally as a player or as an beginner cod is actually the best game I've ever seen in my gaming sight. But the main thing about it is it's size and consisting of huge amount of data. It's so exciting to see such masterpieces available on mobile, and that too for free. The developers have put in every little detail necessary to make this game a unique experience, while keeping in mind the compatibility with mobile phones. Of course, you wouldn't get an experience like that on consoles or PC's, but it still is better than most shooter games on mobile. No major bugs or flaws. Easily one of my favorite mobile games. People who are hating this probably are new to shooter games.

Loving everything about it man. The asethetics, the feel, the sound and score, the gameplay is amazing. Controls and auto pick-up lag a bit, but not enough to ruin the experience. Even the Battle Royal mode feels like an actual battle when you play in squads. Great work team...(all those behind creating this) Fix some minor lags and you have got the recipe for a great shooter at hands.

Frankly one of the best games I've ever played. I rate it the best of its kind, definitely. This game is absolutely UNREAL!!! Just as good as the console play and battlepasses are really NOT NECESSARY. I got one myself but for over 6/7 months played without. Easy to get new guns. Really enjoyable, I see a whole lot of similarities with pubg mobile, probably because they're both tencent games, but that's not a bad thing. First off, I am not a bot commenting to gain stars. This is an amazing game and really easy to get good at. I have yet to have lost 1 round on team death match, battle royal, or control point. I am decent at cod on console but I am amazing on here thanks to the easy to use controls, straight forward gameplay, and amazing guns. I highly reccomend giving this game a try as it is by far the best mobile game to have ever been released. Thank you for reading my opinion now go play!

The game is more like counter strike , battle Royale mod needs more updates. Needs more maps, and colorful player skins rather than dull soldier outfit. I am seriously impressed. The game runs incredibly well on my Oppo AS5x which is a budget phone. The controls are well designed, they clearly took some inspiration from Shadow Legends controls, which is good because it works! And the customization options for controls are seriously impressive, allowing everyone to find the scheme that suits them. The graphics options are another impressive thing, something you almost never see on mobile games. I got sick of CoD years ago, but I'm loving this.

A great game, but pretty broken.

Ok so I'm changing my initial review. This Game Was by far the best fps Game on mobile! Best graphics. Amazing game play. Offers many different game modes and types, all available to all types of players. While this game does simulate monetisation, the vast majority of it is cosmetics. The control layout could be a little better, maybe allow more customisation options and something that explains what they do, like hybrid ADS. Still unsure on how it differs.

An excellent game with smooth controls, many game modes, and a large number of maps. It runs so smoothly on my Samsung Galaxy Note9, and is really a joy to play. The graphics are some of the best I've seen for mobile. My favourite game modes are the battle royale and hard point, which are both just awesome. Great jobs dev and entire community of game.

Call of duty is a game I played for longest time in my life. Literally one of the best games I've played. Seems to be a lot where you assume your going to play 1st person mode but then when you go into it, it's a strategic mode looking down at an area but not this. Get a shotgun & go looking for somebody who's p*ssed you off. Simple. Completely free & a proper old school shootout!

This game is fantastic! Play alone or with friends and never run out of things to try and explore. No need to spend a dime on the game and you will still be equal with everyone else. The only time to spend is when they release new skins that you just have to have. I've spent plenty and I'm always satisfied with the purchase. Some complain about glitches but I assure you they are very minimal, and I challenge anyone to create a mobile game this dense and entertaining without occasional bugs.

The game glitches now and again, also the server crashes Abit too many times and sometimes it doesn't work after a certain hour. It would be 5 stars if that wasn't the problem. Other than those problems the game is amazing and I love it. Just work on those problems and the game will be beyond amazing.

Call of Duty Mobile has great graphics and gameplay. The controls are smooth and responsive, and the game runs well on most devices. There's a good variety of game modes, including team deathmatch, free-for-all, and zombie mode. The leveling system is fun and addictive, and there are plenty of unlockable weapons, perks, and skins to keep players engaged. The matchmaking system is also well-designed, with player of similar skill level matched together

Awesome game indeed, really good. And interesting, and the voice chat is awesome. Playing with people around the world making friends in the real world by talking to them straight in the game. Really enjoyable game. Unfortunately had to do a factory reset on my phone for a different reason and didn't realise this would cause me to lose everything I'd achieved. Call of Duty Mobile is an absolute powerhouse of a game! From the moment I downloaded it, I was hooked. The graphics are stunning, the controls are smooth, and the gameplay is addictive. What I love most is the variety it offers. Whether you prefer intense multiplayer battles or thrilling zombie survival modes, Call of Duty Mobile has it all. The constant updates and new content keep the game fresh and exciting. Keep Playing...

Brilliant addition to the call of duty franchise One thing that annoys me though... headshots dont always work, in fact some of the time you can stand there point blank shooting someone for 3+ seconds and they dont die, they shoot you once and your out cold waiting for the respawn... This game is absolute FIRE. My favorite mode is Multiplayer, you get to practice and have FUN. Will reccommend 100%. Battle Royale is also great, playing solos are AMAZING. I wish controller support would be added to the menus as well, since it's pretty cumbersome when I have my phone hooked up to my TV for playing. Recommended!

I had great expectations from this game as I have grown up playing Call of Duty games on PC. For the first time we are able to play it as multiplayer on phone! I wish they add campaign mode also but I don't think that will happen. The gameplay in this varies with the game mode played and there are quite a few here. The interface is simple yet sophisticated, can be made a little bit snappy by removing the useless animations used sometimes. Overall I would recommend it.

Quick and easy to understand and simple to play. Controls are very good. But at times i feel as if the buttons are not responding (e.g if your hipfiring to ads... Etc.)

The game is exceptional it has great features and a realistic game play & the infrastructure is awesome. The Graphics are on point and I find it exciting with all the different match modes it has. But I find a problem with the control's section it's just too packed up. It makes it hard to handle sometimes but overall the game is good.

Fantastic game, love the Battle Royal, I've had latency issues which sucks but so far it seems they've optimized on it in the latest version. I don't like how expensive the crates and such are, I'd be more willing to gamble if the prices weren't so steep... currently I try resist the gambling temptation and stick to only paying for the battle pass and being content with that content. The game isn't pay to win, purchases are all cosmetic focused, and you can opt to play the game for free.

This game has zero quality and effort put into it compared to the console and Pc version. All of the servers are so slow and i cant find matches as fast as i used to. The games has no where near the amount of creativity as the rest of the call of duty franchise and relies on in app purchases for actual enjoyment out of the game. The game was great when i first got it and now its just another game i cant stand. I still play it as it is the only fps call of duty game on mobile. But it is bad.

As a player who tried this after pubgm, this is an absolutely awful game. With fancy stuff like upgradable guns and special abilities etc. as if it were a two year old's game. Good game. I have played several similar games but I keep coming back to this game. However I would like to put forward several suggestions to make this game even better 1) Please make this game smaller in size . Occasionally, The game feels laggy . This could help players who have very high ping.

Bot matches should allow us to choose a map because it's very frustrating having to do it while dying time and time again on multiplayer; matchmaking shouldn't put you on matches with people 50+ levels above you, it's a waste of time to play these because you don't have room to breathe. The game is great. It's a must play for a call of duty fan. It has a lot of modes that are interesting and fun. The gameplay, controls and mechanics are very good. The battle royale mode has 'the call of duty touch' which adds abilities that can be chosen. Thia makes the battle royale mode different from all other battle rouale games. The only things that need fixing in this game are the bag(inventory) layout in battle royale and the third person view which just looks odd(since COD is a FPSgame).

Its an amazing game....great graphics, great gameplay, brilliant concepts. With the introduction of gunsmith, u can even customise ur own weapons! Only problem is players become invisible sometimes and u have to depend on the red shoulders to get a kill. Another problem is the constant desync. This game keeps introducing new mods, new maps, new guns every season and hence keeps it fresh. It is overall an amazing game.

Best shooting game available for Android at the moment. The Battle Royale mod is yet behind PUBG, but it's still promising. The multiplayer mod is unbeatable. My only complain about it is on a very specific control setting limitation. There is this ADS and fire button that allows you to aim while shooting with the scope on that only works properly if you're used to hitting the fire button that is on the right side of the screen, which is not my case.

The Best FPS on Android Device, no doubt! I had tons of fun playing the game during the Beta Test, and now after finally the Global Release, this game just keeps getting better.I like the Multiplayer mode, its fast paced, adrenaline pumping mode, whereas the Battle Royale is much more intense and well planned than the already existing BR games like PUBG. The classes for BR are hands down the best! Would had loved a single player campaign too, but i understand its not happening. Be sure to play!

Good game. But needs to be better optimized for performance, specifically, frame rates. Especially for mid to low end devices. A really fun game don't get me wrong, but there was this bug that put me right off. There are two errors in the game, which I consider to be defects. 1. The battle royale map is bad and does not contain many buildings. 2. This is a very great game. Loved the experience. But my phone started to become warm when I played this for about half an hour. The game play is great, graphics are also mind blowing. The game is really good and I'm thoroughly enjoying it during this quarantine period. My ONE and ONLY issue is how of late, approximately 3 days in a row, I can't seem to play smoothly. Marvelous game, have no game breaking bugs that I have encountered. There is a few bugs that will make the performance of the game a bit worse however nothing major. No crashes. Love the game overall and would love to see where it goes in the future. However I have a suggestion, why not add a Campaign mode? I'm sure it would broaden your player base and lots of people would love to see it. Thanks.

A great mobile call of duty! If only they got rid of the premium packages itc.. but I guess they need to make money one way or the other.. I really love the CoD franchise for a ton of reasons. But since like the past few seasons I've been facing a huge number of ping spikes which makes the game totally unplayable. Call of Duty Mobile offers an immersive gaming experience with diverse maps, engaging multiplayer modes, and impressive graphics on mobile devices. The controls are intuitive, providing a smooth transition for both casual and hardcore players. Regular updates and a variety of weapons and skins contribute to its lasting appeal. However, occasional connectivity issues and in-app purchases might deter some players. Overall, it's a solid mobile adaptation of the iconic franchise.

Good game. But needs to fix some bugs in the new update 1- Sound glitch BR - cannot hear the sound of the enemy or own vehicle at some times. 2- BR game gets stuck at some times. At some times the game is not smooth, There was a lag for about 1 second. Please fix that. 3- The sound of the BR drone gets stuck after found an enemy. Sound keeps lagging. Overall the game is good. Only those problems i found with the new update. Kindly requesting to fix those bugs. Thank you!

honestly, very fun and easy to play, you can set your control's size, where you want it to be and it can fit your hand type and comfortable-ness. it's very good for beginners, because with this game i actually learned how to aim, simple to play, has voice chat, you can but dont have to friend people, different weapons and doesn't lag (though that is more due to your device). graphics are very good actually, and all the best to this game.

Since 2019, the game has been flawless and addictive. The gameplay is excellent and unparalleled by any other battle royale mobile game out now, and the graphics are incredible. However, battle pass doesn't always provide the best deals to those players who could potentially use this game to highlight a point, and then these deals often come out as ridiculous. Top players continue to use default skins because new skins, for instance, resemble clowns rather than being soldier-oriented.

This game is by far an E3 Mobile winner. I would not give this a 5 star rating, due to its delay of controls and its framerate. The lag is as annoying as getting a shard of glass in you back. What im also having another problem is the low level of items to use. Best thing to do is either put all items as useable in private and as well add a offline mode, or local. If you can add any or all of them into the game, you will lighten my heart. Keep up the great work! From Honors, SNiF Templar.

Great graphics and good game... but the cost if crates, draws and other purchasable items are far overpriced, especially the cost of the draws! What's the point? Make it cheaper and more people will buy... Also, bits are great for beginners, but after a few games, we dont want to see a single bot, ok? Especially when you put a bot in that gets MVP! Use people's profile names etc and turn them into bots... clever, but annoying...

The best game ive eve installed. Quike downloads and fast loading. Fun misiones, tasks, and challenges. Easy and very costumisable controls. And the guns/weapons are very detailed just like the characters and maps. Just perfect. The only problem is that almost all characters, weapons, or just items that you may want have sort of crates and banners that cost money to buy. Money which some people might not want to spend on a game. And a few minor glitches and errors. But most are quickly resolved

Is exactly what it says on the tin, CoD on Mobile devices.. with that comes all the horror of mobile gaming, particularly pay to win elements, progression feels really slow due to new perks and weapons being so spaced out through the levels. Controls are also not great, to play effectively youll need to adopt some sort of claw hand tactic and adjust the button layouts and sizes. All in all though its still good if you want the CoD experience for free. Would not advise paying for this though

The game is great, really good to play with friends and spend time. However the game is greedy, reaching some levels you get nothing but useless rewards ,only dumb camo and some points to buy useless things that no one wants, you need to pay for all interesting things such as guns and characters, and somehow if your friend doesn't have that character (didn't buy it) she/he can't see it. Need to be less greedy guys.

Love this game! It keeps me busy and passes the time. I started very docile and not really challenging people. But after a while of having it, I started to put myself to the test and challenge other players. I regret not doing so before! Only downfall is the expense to get a bad@ss character. I'd need to spend $50 usd to get one because I'd have to unlock everything before getting it and/or the mythical/legendary weapon.

This is honestly the best mobile game I've ever played it feels and looks like an old school cod game but on a phone sometimes you forgot your playing a mobile game and the best bit is that you dont even have to pay to win! Yes you can put money on if you want but you can progress just as easily for free it comes down to how much skill and time you put into it not how much money.

This game has leaderboards for everyone. Even individual weapons leaderboards. Its always got something new to enjoy. Still recommended. Also no ad spams at all. Thanks for that. Love it Now about the ads. I hate them. I watch an ad just to have a 10 second wait, to get a pic of the ad with a double arrow on it to press and exit. That brings me to another pic of the ad for 5 seconds to click the x and I'm made to wait again. Its More time trying to exit an ad then to watch it. What's with that.

Just wish there was also a story based missions options and not only just PvP. Otherwise it's awesome. I would also like to see an option in game that either pops up or is a clickable icon that displays what tasks have been completed or still needs to be completed whilst playing, instead of only being able to see which tasks have been completed or need to be completed once in lobby.

Ok first of all the graphics of the multiplayer mode is amazing. Good job developers. But when you play the battleroyal mode the graphics goes from best to 'ok i have seen worse.' I don't know if it was my device's problem, but when i cranked up my graphics to maximum wnd played a battleroyal match it became really hot, too hot that it was uncomfortable to handle the device. Overall it is an Ok type of game. But for all those pubg players, don't change to this.

Who would've thought that out of all the FPS it would be COD to get it so right! It really feels like a modern console COD that has been ported almost 1:1 from the most iconic maps and gameplay from its main titles. The controls are very responsive and surprisingly accurate. And for the cherry on top, they added a Battle Royale Mode that is pretty solid! The only gripe I have are minor bugs, for example whenever you aim downsights and tap the map icon, it won't come up. Otherwise, fantastic!

Well, I'm changing my review to a 4 star from 5 star now. Reason is that even though the game has progressed so much in terms of content since it was released, after the recent balance changes we had, the game isn't as well optimised as it used to be, there's lag, frame drops, and sometimes connectivity issues for no reason at all. Please fix the issues.

Just go for it . It's for stuck on the initial opening screen and there is cool 3d animation is enabled where some guys are standing with the guns that's it. it won't say anything . Codm is surprisingly good. Better then I could ever expect. Gun play in good. You can be conpatitive with pay a single cent. A new gun and map every season. A lot of replayability. It takes up a lot of space. I got up to 5gb on my phone. So if your phone doesn't have a lot memory don't play it. Controls are hard. If you are fine with all the negatives, it's a must play.

Good job Activision, good job. This game is really good BUT I doubt low end devices will handle it. Maybe on the lowest graphics setting, but I still doubt it. Big game, lots of features, lots of fun. One downside is that it has a bit of hitbox issues, it isn't noticeable too much but sometimes you get hit even tho you are not where the enemy is aiming at, ofc the same goes to enemy players, I had ridiculous kills where I didn't see them but still got em, besides that it's a perfect game 👌

Amazing game, never gets boring. 10/10 for gameplay. However there there sometimes problems when buying in game currency and they removed zombies mode! Why?? Is also faulty for a lot of people I know but still works well for others. Good luck

Really smooth, deals with inevitable latency relatively fairly given it's fairly new. At higher ranks in Multiplayer however, things get iffy. The delay, regardless of how good connection is on your side, is ridiculous, and unfortunately, that 94ms is the difference between a fair fight and waiting for death to catch up on your screen on elite and up. The weapons are also getting pretty tired(already), could stand for some additions, (no, re-skins dont count).

The gameplay itself is amazing, this is the best fps you can get on mobile platforms, but players with controllers or on tablets will have a massive advantage over the rest. The problem lies in the microtransactions, not only they're lootboxes but they're the most expensive I've ever seen in any game, ever. At least recent changes have been going in the right direction and adding a way to play for them. Still you're likely to only get trash.

An excellent time, I've had this game for about a month or two now, although the game has bugs, like sometimes not being able to hear others in match lobbies or while in game both MP or BR (or your friends having the same issue vice versa). A rare occurrence but sometimes the app or my phone will just shut down automatically and people can sometimes kill you after you run around a wall they're not supposed hit (yes ik about penetration with some walls) love the game but definitely needs work.

Super fun, great thing to hear that this supports other controllers/devices that we can use in this game! This game is not boring at all, no cheaters I found, no donkeys, and overall, this game is a badass, I recommend this. I don't care if it takes more shots to kill an enemy! I seen other reviews about this and I don't understand what about it, you'll think it takes more less shots for you to die but more shots for you to shoot at the current enemy as you see but it's actually equal.

The game is decent. Graphics are good, maps are good but this won't be anything special in the near future. Team matches are full of bots that do nothing but provide kills to enemies. Great game - The fact it's on mobile has slowed the gameplay ever so slightly due to the controls, but this is platform related and certainly nothing wrong with the game. It seems to lean slightly towards sniper gameplay due to the ever so slightly decreased lace, but sniping is by no means overpowered. EDIT: Lost a few stars to matchmaking. At level 40, you're suddenly paired with people level 100+, which is a whole different game. It's a very sudden change.

Flawless! Really like it being cross platform so I can play with my iPhone friends. Good maps coming from the COD series. Wish Terminal comes sooner or later. No controller support tho. One of the best mobile games. If you dont have a phone with 4gb ram it just wont work. People need to understand that you need a decent phone to play smoothly. I read other review complaining about the controls and that you NEED a controller. That is not true this is just on you abilities as a player. I can use all the button slide shoot and aiming. If you are not good at mobile games, have stiff fingers and your phone isnt good then dont review or at least review honestly. This game is great!

This game is arguably the best F2P fps shooter on mobile. It has the smoothest controls of any mobile shooter, the content is constant and interesting, and it's just pretty satisfying. Unfortunately, lag and freezing happen a bit too often for my liking, and it tends to happen in a life or Death situation. It's also not P2W, so that's a bonus.

Really good game with many modes and features. Follows the Battle Pass structure as other games on market now, has a minor system for loot box, but it doesn't seems to be a focus, only serving to give smaller prizes for mission and ads (sprays, skins and gestures) Just like other Tencent games, it wants to make itself an esport game. And for now I don't have anything to say against it's market strategy.

The game is legit. 5 stars for motivation, cuz y'all doin the right thing. More emphasis on bugs and the leave-app resume fix. I'm updating for 2nd Season now. I already know it's gonna be better than before cuz y'all are on the right track. Recommendations: Zombie Mode. I grew up playing that. 4 player Team against zombies on a barely functional bus was soo much fun. Anyway, keep up the good work.

Honestly one of the best fps mobile games. I really like the ability to link a controller to the game via bluetooth but its still fun to play even without one. I doubt they actually matchmake me against other players with controllers because I see no diffrence in game play but 🤷‍♂️. I do miss zombies though, which is why its a 4 star right now. Zombies was alot of fun to play on mobile because you could pause and save the game to play for later. I hope they add it back.

After every 3 to 4 games the game crashes, it either stays black or it keeps searching for players while my teamates are already in the game. And then when I clear it and restart, It says I can't join the same game, so I have to quit the game, sometimes I get a penalty and sometimes I won't. But the gameplay is fluent. I have xperia xz2.. Can you guys sort this issue.? I know its not a problem with my mobile coz it handles all high graphic intensive games at max resolution with ease.

It's an excellent game, considering it's on mobile. The controls feel easy to use, gameplay feels smooth, it's just an overall great game. this is the most mind blowing game I've ever seen in my life. I always choose this game ro relieve my stress and its so wonderful.

Honestly, it's a good game. Doesn't disappoint at all, plenty of weapons, maps, modes, everything. But the biggest problem is it's size - takes up 15 GB or more. If it was possible to move games to SD card (had that feature in some of my older phones), I would have bought a 32 GB one just so I can move this game to it and play. But unfortunately I had to delete it after playing a few days due to lack of space.

As for me, the fps is high, the game is not crashing, not lagging, not freezing etc. The only downside of the game is the painfully arcade shooting mechanis, that's not giving the Player anh challenge. All the bullets are going straight to the center, sometimes even not on ADS, thus the game is, unfortunately, boring. BR is another story, when you can revive a dead teammate, heal both you and your team-mates using some magic, AND there is no fall damage.

It's a very good game, but there are some problems like the enormous amount of battery consumption it's just abnormal and all the time I'm there in the middle of a gun fight and the character doesn't shoot then I realize it's because sometimes the walk button is pressed instead of the fire button the walk commands should be fixed and not change depending on where you click.

Battle royale still needs some love. The map is far too big for a mobile game. It would also be nice to have things like buy stations and contracts, similar to warzone. The new zombies event is nice, and they should keep doing them but it would be fantastic to have the classic maps and round based horde mode back. Multiplayer is great but there seems to still be a glitch when you select "play again" where you end up stuck in the same game mode rather than cycling through the modes you selected

Game is awesome..! It becomes laggy in the next update and I can barely played it. Often, the game freezes and there are times when I think it looks like I played a shooter game with 30 frameskip, which is killing the animation itself and running around feels like teleporting. It got worse when I found enemy, it doubles the lag and I have no choice but to stop playing. I'm quite disappointed but I believe the dev will do something about this and solve it ASAP.

Would've given a 4/5. But there's a lot of issue coming up whenever I open the game. All my internet connected apps are running perfectly but when I start the game it says "download configuration failed. Make sure your device is connected to a network and then restart the game". Yeah it starts eventually(!) but sometimes it just takes forever to start the game (like right now) Apart from this everything else is fine and good to go and hoping for fixing minor and developmental issues.

I have been playing Call of Duty Mobile since Season 1. I've bought every gamepass, and they are all awesome, filled with awesome gear and guns. Battle Royale is fun to do. You can do short film movies in a Private Battle Royale map. Zombies is really good. But when you make the special zombie called Brutus mad he runs at you at high speed. So that might need a fix. Settings and controls are adjustable to your liking. Ranked points are hard to get. That was my experience from Season 1 to now. 👍

I have tried many other shooter games but in my opinion, it's the best. Let me tell you its reason. Actually i have to say reasons. First of all, it has a plenty of game modes which PUBG doesn't have. For example; team deathmatch, domination, search and destroy etc. Probably my favourite is domination. There are also a few modes which are added every week/month. You can customize your weapons, characters, even the vehicles and your parachute in battle royale. In conclusion, play it.

I didn't have high expectations when downloading this. I thought it would be impossible for a touch-screen mobile device to host a Call of Duty game which looks and feels authentic to the franchises major console titles. Needlessly to say, I was wrong. My phone is over two years old now, yet game play runs flawlessly and controls are very comfortable. Much to my surprise, I'm not being inundated with third party ads either. This game is exceptionally good value (well, it's FREE) and impeccably designed. Getting a head-shot on a mobile is just as fun as landing the same on console.

It's a good time burner and you don't really have to pay to play which is nice for a change. The flaws are the controls, not having enough fingers for the buttons no matter how I configured it. I can't look, run, aim and shoot at the same time but other than that I enjoy it. Bots are on the early stages but as you rank up you will find many tough gamer humans.

The game is awesome, between all the FPS available in the Play Store this is by far the best. The graphics are good even on low settings, the controls are responsive (most of the time) and there are lots of free rewards monthly. There's one thing that I noticed though, when I play Battle Royale the performance drops noticeably, the frames seem to fall down and it's not that smooth. I guess is because of the huge map and all that so maybe its normal. Overall, really fun. Thats all that matters!

The game is amazing. The graphics are crisp and gameplay is just amazing. The stability is a huge issue though. The game freezes and crashes way too often. Following a crash, if you restart the game, the voice chat often stops working. If the game crashes on starting battle royale, then restarting the game and trying to connect back often leads to starting a random match where you aren't a part of the squad. The game would have been amazing if not for the frequent crashes and freezing.

For me its an epic game. I've been playing this for 2 months and so far its great. It gets harder too which is nice that there are no bots when you play a lot. But when you just start the game there only will be bots so that it goes easy to harder. I wish for the battle pass to be free means completing challenges for the battle pass. So if you could add like that for the next update, a lot of people would like it. But some times the audio of it lags. So far a nice game.

As someone who loves playing video games, I was hesitant when I found out there was a COD Mobile. However, I downloaded it. And, I am extremely impressed, it's not perfect, but it's extremely well done. Graphics are great, controls are great, nothing really to complain about besides the fact that when it shows the final kill you take like 10 shots and non of which actually hit them except on a RARE occasion but other then that, great game. ❗

Awesome! Great gameplay, very addictive. The interface is a bit confusing at first, but you'll get the gist of it pretty quickly after playing a few rounds. My only gripe is that the movement controls sometimes lag or don't register. I also tend to aim for the head and it works well. And then I get killed and the kill cam shows enemy sniper shooting me in the leg and killing me instantly. That's a but frustrating :)

Since Black Ops 1 and 2 arent remastered for PS4, I havent been able to play them. This game is actually really nostalgic for me, and also really fun to play. My phone is about the same size as a PS3 controller, luckily enough. The maps are just great, the game is fantastic.. My internet is bad, so it is a pain to last through a good few matches, but I guess it's not the games fault.

The only problem in this game are bots. Too many bots, it's so hard to find a real competition. Other than that, it's a really great game. New seasons every month with exciting themes. But I think you guys should really fix some graphics issues, like change the graphics of the grass and leaves on the trees, they look too bad even when I am playing on Very High Graphic Mode. And secondly, the blood. The graphics of blood are really bad on Very High Mode. It's better on Medium though.

Love this game. Just a few things I'd wish to see. For starters, something like an archive, which features bio of all heroes and villains throughout the series. Second, a grind option to earn some CPs. Finally, an option to wield two different classes at the same time, at the cost of extra recovery time or so. Frankly speaking, the upgrade slots for the weapons should not have been capped at 5, to achieve the ultimate settings.

After a couple of recent updates the game has become very hard and heavy. The fluid movement is gone. It feels like a struggle, both in mobile and emulator. It feels like the characters carry a lot of burden. I have tried several settings, even putting my setting into the lowest except the framerate to the max, but yet it doesn't work. I run the game in a decent setup with core i5 and external graphics card of 2GB memory and 20 GB of RAM, and guess what, still it's a struggle.

Great experience for a mobile platform! This has become a must game as long as it keeps playable for my phone. There are too many buttons at the beginning but after playing it for days (I stopped working and eating) it's easier I just needed to adapt my fingers. I tried to use a Xbox 360 wired controller but it didn't work. I might buy a Bluetooth controller on Amazon or something like that. But it would be nice if you say the best compatible controllers. I feel it confusing with many gifts etc

Great game. Such fun. Really recommend it. Has a game mode for everyone and there is a definite good feel about the game. I love it and can't stop playing... The only issue with the game for me is that low end androids can only access the lower graphics settings so it is a bit of a downfall. I have also recently noticed that the game struggles to connect to WiFi and I disconnect quite a bit (not loads but more than I'm comfortable with)

Very good experience for a mobile game. Varied selection of maps from throughout COD history & different game modes to keep things interesting. Most notable issue is the 'black screen of death' where screen goes dark. Though you remain in game, you cannot control your character at all and will most likely die. Most often encountered in the Battle Royale mode. Otherwise the game is fun & doesn't require long wait times for matches. A mixed bag mode with different game types should be considered.

Great game. My main gripe is that those who spend real money on upgrades seem to be able to run quicker in game, which gives them an unfair advantage. It's also unfair that a game designed for mobiles allows you to use a controller so some players have a huge movement advantage and can jump and spin and move while shooting while the rest of us are hindered using touch screen controls

Its a very good game. I play it everyday. Great effects and classes for various types of players. The skins are awesome. Would have like to have a feature when you get a notification if I'm are offline and my friends send me an invite to play. That could be really helpful. As everyime I have to message a friend and then get back to the game it resets and reboots which makes it annoying.

Pro:- Excellent game! I have been a fan of call of duty since my childhood. I have grown playing call of duty. I like the game very much. This game is no exception. It has excellent graphics. Cons :- their is some network issues that is happening while playing. But it will be fixed some. Some work should be done on the battle royale. It is not as stable. Conclusion:- this game is no exception. It is an Excellent game. It is definitely gonna rock in the all app stores.

Brilliant game. Love it to bits. I am definitely addicted. I have to play at least once in the day. I love all the game features and modes. Only thing is though after playing it for a while I feel Battle Royal needs a new map. One should be able to choose the map as well. Also for featured games as well we should be allowed to pick our maps. Somethings I get the same map 5 times in a row and that's really annoying especially if it is a map you don't like.

This is a great game with excellent graphics. I do wish it had slightly better decals for things like the grass, and an increased resolution for textures. Please cater for higher end devices!
